sloka: तत्र न अमुदितः कश्चिन् न अत्र कश्चित् असत् प्रियः ।अहनि अहनि वर्धन्ते गुणाः तत्र मनोरमाः ॥४-४३-५२॥
transliteration: tatra na amuditaḥ kaścin na atra kaścit asat priyaḥ ।ahani ahani vardhante guṇāḥ tatra manoramāḥ ॥4-43-52॥

translations.english: 'By virtue of their meritorious deeds (done in the previous birth) they live a luxurious life of riches and sensual pleasures with their female partners.
